name: CRdesign
facts: Family business founded in 2001, originally hand-painting tin pictures.
Since 2004 tin and zinc spin casting of small metal castings.
Products: belt buckles, Christmas decorations, key fobs, badges, breastpins, medals, company logos, game pawns, glassware labels.
Made to order from origination to final product; galvanic plating available.
All pieces shown belong to clients and are not for sale.
